periodo = 202601  # parámetro (&periodo)
sql_resumen = """
SELECT a.id, b.region, SUM(a.monto) AS total
FROM GOB.dbo.VENTAS a
INNER JOIN GOB.dbo.SUCURSALES b ON a.suc = b.suc
WHERE a.periodo = ?
GROUP BY a.id, b.region
"""
resumen = pd.read_sql(sql_resumen, engine, params=(periodo,))
with engine.begin() as conn:
    conn.exec_driver_sql("DELETE FROM GOB.dbo.RESUMEN WHERE periodo = ?", (periodo,))
resumen.to_sql("RESUMEN", engine, schema="dbo", if_exists="append", index=False)
